en.headline: 375 own commits and 533 automated ones across 16 repos, with 52 issues
en.teaser: A month of building OpenCode skill tooling and a deep-research skill, plus a steady stream of bug reports to OpenChamber and opencode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-26 with no missing days. Grand totals are 375 commits, 8 pull requests, 52 issues and 0 reviews, with 533 additional automated commits recorded separately.

### Profile automation and daily reporting

Most own commits landed in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where a daily GitHub activity report was built: Pages plus an AI summary, a rolling two-hour update, a workflow_dispatch date input, and corrected counting so that statistics and item splits cannot diverge. Copy was made neutral across the activity card and README, CI was moved to checkout/setup-node v7, and a test-render assertion collector bug was fixed.

### Deep research and translation skills

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` was the second busiest repo. It gained a bilingual, light/dark landing page on GitHub Pages, a first-class observations evidence type with C1-C8 fixes, corpus and CI setup, M1 skill documents with references, milestone-two validation scripts, a Chinese README with a language switch, and branch and English-content docs, shipping four releases from v0.1.0 to v0.4.0. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` was started from scratch: an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, page-state resets between runs, smoke tests, JSDoc checkJs typing and a refactor that dropped selection translation.

### Skill management, sandbox and pickers

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` delivered the skill_management plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, verified trusted publishing over OIDC, and released v0.2.0 and v1.0.0. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` built a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and auth, Windows path pitfalls, oh-my-opencode-slim tests and branch-deletion risks. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, atomic snapshot writes, version-badge checks and SKILL.md restructuring, releasing v1.3.0 and v1.4.0. `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` moved the host-command scan to a registry-first approach across v1.15.0 to v1.15.3 and trimmed skill and checklist docs. `sogeisetsu/myBlog` added OpenChamber capture samples.

### Upstream reporting

Outside the user's own repos, 25 issues were filed to `openchamber/openchamber` and 12 to `anomalyco/opencode`, covering MCP child processes, context panel math, capture resolution, skipped-role notices, thinking-level defaults, quota display, and MiMo vision and subagent failures. One issue each went to `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` and its DeepResearch sibling, and two to `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` about OpenCode skill install paths. Four pull requests opened against `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` addressed review-server disposal, CRLF frontmatter, platform-specific browser commands and eval robustness. Note that dates up to 2026-10-01 were reconstructed via GitHub Search and are approximate; stars are unavailable and releases cover only the user's own repositories.

highlights.text: Four releases, v0.1.0 through v0.4.0, ending with a thin meld.py CLI and gate downgrades.
v1.0.0 froze the skill list/inspect/disable/enable surface for 1.x.
v0.2.0 introduced config-only disabling through a single skill permission rule.
v1.15.0 made the host-command scan registry-first; v1.15.3 closed the series.
fix: harden eval robustness in parsing, aggregation, and install.
Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server.
Go endpoint rejects every image for mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 despite advertised image input.
Idea: VS Code extension should fall back to the OpenCode 2.x shipped with the desktop app.

zh.headline: 16 个仓库共 375 次本人提交、533 次自动提交，另有 52 条 issue
zh.teaser: 这个月主要搭建 OpenCode 技能工具与深度研究技能，同时向 OpenChamber 和 opencode 提交了大量缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-09-27 至 2026-10-26，无缺失日期。总计 375 次提交、8 个拉取请求、52 条 issue、0 次评审，另有 533 次自动提交单独统计。

### 个人主页与日报自动化

本人提交最集中在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，在那里搭建了基于 Pages 与 AI 摘要的每日 GitHub 活动日报，改为每两小时滚动更新，支持工作流手动指定日期，并修正统计口径使数字与条目拆分不再矛盾。还统一了活动卡片与 README 的中性表述，将 CI 升级到 checkout/setup-node v7，并修复 test-render 断言收集器的缺陷。

### 深度研究与翻译技能

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 是第二活跃的仓库：新增中英双语、明暗主题的 Pages 落地页，加入一等公民的 observations 证据类型与 C1-C8 修复、语料与 CI、M1 技能文档、M2 校验脚本、中文 README 及分支和英文内容规范，并从 v0.1.0 连续发布到 v0.4.0。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 从零起步，完成 MV3 骨架、提供商协议层与预设、模型列表和术语表管线，实现分块双语页面渲染、熔断与进度显示，随后修复页面状态重置、补充冒烟测试和 JSDoc 类型检查，并移除划词翻译。

### 技能管理、沙箱与选择器

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 实现了 skill_management 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 动作，用 OIDC 验证了可信发布，并发布 v0.2.0 与 v1.0.0。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 建立知识库，归档 OpenCode V2 分发、架构与认证、Windows 路径坑、oh-my-opencode-slim 实测与远程分支删除风险。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 新增 agent-discovery 与 snapshot-summary 脚本、原子快照写入、版本徽章校验和 SKILL.md 渐进披露，发布 v1.3.0 与 v1.4.0。`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 将宿主命令扫描改为注册表优先，发布 v1.15.0 至 v1.15.3 并精简技能与检查清单文档。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 补充了 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游问题反馈

在本人仓库之外，向 `openchamber/openchamber` 提交 25 条 issue，向 `anomalyco/opencode` 提交 12 条，涉及 MCP 子进程残留、上下文面板计算、截图分辨率、跳过角色提示合并回复、思考强度默认值和配额显示，以及 MiMo 视觉与子代理失败。另向 `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` 及其 DeepResearch 仓库各提 1 条，向 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` 提 2 条关于 OpenCode 技能安装路径的问题。在 `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 提交 4 个拉取请求，分别处理评审服务器释放、CRLF 前言、跨平台浏览器打开和评测健壮性。需说明：2026-10-01 及之前的数据由 GitHub Search 回溯，属于近似值，星标数不可用，发布信息仅覆盖本人仓库。

highlights.text: 从 v0.1.0 到 v0.4.0 共四次发布，最终引入精简的 meld.py 命令行与校验门槛调整。
v1.0.0 将 list/inspect/disable/enable 接口在 1.x 中冻结。
v0.2.0 通过单条 skill 权限规则实现仅改配置的禁用。
v1.15.0 将宿主命令扫描改为注册表优先，v1.15.3 收尾该系列。
修复：增强解析、聚合与安装环节的评测健壮性。
自动发现开发服务器实际执行了第一条已保存动作，而非发现服务器。
Go 端点对 mimo-v2.6-flash 和 mimo-v2.5 的所有图片返回 400，尽管其宣称支持图片输入。
想法：VS Code 扩展应回退使用桌面应用自带的 OpenCode 2.x。
